vote.reason: Evidence: the render facts are real but the finding's key licensing claim is wrong and one claim is overstated. Verified on pdp-deck-m-js-full.png: text rows 1206–1298 (inside the cited 1180–1336) show «בלילה, על השביל» / «אור נמוך, קרוב לאדמה, שמלווה את הדרך.» / «למדריך לבחירת תאורה ←», no photograph (verify.json pdp-deck-m-js pdpSections[0]: imgs 0, h 156); h1 «תאורה סולארית עמידה למים לדק ולמדרגות»; kicker at y≈538–544 «תאורת שביל, עמוד וגינה · מתאים כדי לראות את הדרך» (≈660 px above). ens_head_map at scene.liquid lines 269–271 is only set inside the birch frame entry (line 93) — correct. BUT: (a) «שביל, מדרגות ומעברים» is NOT the collection title — the real collection title on the render (kicker, menu, footer, mirror JSON) is «תאורת שביל, עמוד וגינה»; the phrase the finding cites is the v2-era place pair in the root brief/BRIEF.md §3 line 64 (and retired elmsnest-v2-* files), so the word is licensed but by a different source than stated. (b) «nothing on the page says מדרגות after the title» is false on the mirror: the facts section's description block («לא עוד מדרגות שנעלמות בחושך… פס אור חם ומדויק לכל מדרגה, דק או שביל… לאורך המדרגות, השביל או המעקה») says it repeatedly, though behind <details>. (c) pdp2/ has no COPY.md to list the heading in (only concepts/*/COPY.md, OWNER-SECTION.json, DEPLOY-LOG.md). Scope: this contests an explicit SPEC decision with a recorded reason — SPEC opening paragraph «the place heading that is true on every product», §1 text block (heading = the elmsnest-s-place word per family, override only via map/block), §2 row «A heading, path … the licensed place word; true with or without a photograph», §3 listing waterproof-solar-deck-step-lights among the twelve text-only products, §5 «Copy on the page byte-identical to §2 per family». The finding does not show that decision failing on the render: the heading is not false for this product — its own listing names the path as one of its places («לכל מדרגה, דק או שביל»), it is in the path collection, and the kicker the owner already approved says the same place word; the «twice» point is a one-word overlap («הדרך») with the kicker, while SPEC §2 deliberately avoids the kicker's infinitive («Not said: … the kicker's infinitive») and the same line renders on every path product, not just the deck. The proposed fix (a heading-only case entry using ens_head_map) is feasible, cheap and honesty-safe since «מדרגות» is in the root BRIEF §3 licensed pair, but it would add new copy outside §2 and so needs a SPEC/owner-copy amendment rather than being a defect of the deployed result; a taste-level polish, not a failure of the contract.

vote.reason: Evidence: partly real. On pdp-path-m-js-full.png (390×4229) the crop at y 950–1150 shows «לא מתאים כשהמקום כמעט אינו מקבל אור יום.» under the terms line, the crop at y 1700–1900 shows the dusk row with both sentences, and the facts below print «טעינה ממוצעת כ־6 שעות»; verify.json pdp-path-m-js and pdp-deck-m-js carry the dusk text verbatim (h 135). So the three sentences and their positions are as described. What is NOT there is a violation: the three are different statements (a threshold warning «almost no daylight → not suitable», a proportional general fact with no number, and a spec number), not one sentence printed twice; SPEC §5 acceptance («no spec repeated») is met because line 2 carries no hours, no number, no spec; BRIEF §3 explicitly licenses «a general fact about the sun … is not a product claim» and its «do not print them twice» rule is about the facts' specs (IP65, hours, lumens), none of which line 2 repeats. Scope: the finding attacks a decision the SPEC records with a reason — §2 B line 2 «the sun dependency as a general fact — no number, no hours; the positive of the not-for line without its words», and the opening paragraph names it «the shopper's favourite sentence» that survived five judges; concepts/scene/COPY.md line 40 shows the overlap with the not-for line was weighed at concept time and kept deliberately. The task rule is not to report what the SPEC explicitly decided unless the render shows it failing; the render shows exactly the overlap the SPEC already knew and accepted (different words, 750 px apart, inside the ≤160 px row: 135 px), and no §5 check fails. The proposed fix (drop line_2) would remove copy the SPEC and the shopper judge chose. It remains a taste note the owner may act on via the line_2 setting already in the schema, which is the SPEC's intended mechanism — not a defect of the deployed result.
